title: The Pearl
author: John Steinbeck
summary: Kino, a poor Mexican pearl diver, finds an enormous pearl that he hopes will change his family's life. Instead it draws greed, threats and violence to his door.
readIf: you want a short, fable-like story about wealth, desire and its cost.
skipIf: you want a hopeful ending or do not like bleak, allegorical stories.
